silhouette.reason: Fur cards now cover the back, flanks, chest and tail, so the outline is shaggy and wild; but the back slopes steeply from high shoulders to low hips and the long narrow muzzle stays, so 3/4 REAR and SIDE read hyena/coyote more than grey wolf.
fixes: level the topline (raise the hips or lower the withers ~5 cm)

proportions.reason: 1.3 x 0.3 x 0.9 m fits the sourced box; chest deeper and ears smaller now, but the head is still small with a long thin snout and the forelegs thin under the heavy fur.
fixes: skull width ~0.55 of skull length with a shorter, deeper muzzle

materials.reason: Fur cards now shade as strands with no dark specks: grizzled dark saddle over buff flanks and a cream chest read as a grey wolf coat (hero.png). The shoulder scars are no longer white strokes but a soft grey smudge; a few pale grey blotches on the chest and shoulder read as smears, and the face is smooth.
fixes: remove the pale grey blotches on the chest and shoulder or break them into lighter guard-hair tips
short fur cards on the face and cheeks

detail.reason: Hair-flow fur cards, chest ruff and cheek fringe, eyes with lids, nose, lip line; the paws now split into toes with claws and a brow plane catches light over the eye, but the muzzle side is still one smooth plane.
fixes: brow tufts and a darker lip margin
cheekbone and muzzle-side planes so the head stops reading as one smooth wedge

wear.reason: Mud is graded, darkest at the toes and fading up the cannon (hero.png, legs); the scars are now paler grey regrowth but at hero distance read as a soft smudge rather than a parted line, and the ear shows only a pale crescent, not a clear nick.
fixes: make the scar parting visible: a thin dark skin line with fur lying away from it
a clear notch cut into one ear rim

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 now carries the dark saddle and a coat value close to LOD0, with no pale slabs, and keeps the back fur cards; the paws are still round buns, a lighter flat facet shows on the hip and the face mask is paler than LOD0.
fixes: darken the LOD2 hip facet and face mask to match LOD0
a few flank cards at LOD2

technical.reason: QA PASS: 107.2k / 28.9k / 3.9k tris, 4 / 4 / 2 draws; LOD0 trimmed to ~107k and LOD2 no longer pops in colour.
fixes: adaptive cell size: finer on head and paws, coarser on flanks
